instruction: The "~/pictures/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/pictures/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.
notes: Single-app task (file_system). Flow mirrors the reference solution: show_profile (username) + show_account_passwords -> login -> show_directory on ~/pictures/vacations/ with recursive=false (asserts directory-listed, which unlocks the statically declared sub-directories) -> compress_directory per sub-directory with compressed_file_path=~/pictures/vacations/<spot>.zip, delete_directory=true, overwrite=true (effects: compressed + directory-deleted, which is exactly what the evaluation checks: new .zip files added, sub-directories and their files removed, no directories added) -> complete_task with no answer. The number of vacation-spot sub-directories is unknown until runtime; the model uses 3 placeholder directory/zip pairs, declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can list every goal condition in its precondition; at runtime the agent repeats compress_directory once per actual listed sub-directory. Boolean API arguments (recursive, delete_directory, overwrite) are modeled as flag objects flag-true/flag-false with static is-true/is-false facts. The extra ?root parameter of compress-directory is not an API argument; it only ties the sub-directory to the listed parent.

plan: (file-system-compress-directory vacation-dir-1 file-system-token vacation-zip-1 flag-true flag-true pictures-vacations-dir)
(file-system-compress-directory vacation-dir-2 file-system-token vacation-zip-2 flag-true flag-true pictures-vacations-dir)
(file-system-compress-directory vacation-dir-3 file-system-token vacation-zip-3 flag-true flag-true pictures-vacations-dir)
